subject: ghost-haven
q: CLOSED — she pushed once, and Bryn put a fist through the wall.
detail:
Dia makes Mercedes look chaste, and Mercedes worked through all forty-four members of the Found Family in three hours on the day she was adopted. The one time Dia came to the main house alone she propositioned everybody, saw cock, said UWU FOR ME?, and could not take no — because nobody had ever told her no about dick before. She pushed. TORIE GOT UNCOMFORTABLE. Bryn solved the danger, through eight inches of wall, and Dia apologised with those knuckles two inches from her head.

So she comes with Eden, who can rein her in. Ask, get rejected, take it at face value, move on. An uncomfortable look before the no and Eden says DEAR, COME HERE from the couch and contains her wife in her lap.

AND THERE IS A WHITEBOARD OVER THE HOLE reading DIA'S ATTEMPTS, with every Ghost Haven woman on it and a tally per visit. The Archive recorded the rule and refused to guess the reason, and the reason turned out to be both worse and funnier than any guess it had.
